description:
Local-first SSH workspace for local shells and remote machines.Zero Electron, zero OpenSSL, zero telemetry, and no app subscription for core SSH workflows.


中文 | English
中文
OxideTerm 2.4.0 新增连接前命令和 XTerminal 的 SSH 连接导入，恢复底部命令栏的命令补全，并更新锁屏、终端排版和分组统计。
🔌 连接与会话管理
- 连接前命令：可为已保存的连接设置在本机执行的命令，例如先启动 VPN 或唤醒主机。命令失败或超时会停止本次连接；在已连接的节点上再开终端不会重复执行。（PR #817）
- 从 XTerminal 导入 SSH 连接：导出文件中的密码和私钥口令会存入受保护的凭据存储，不会出现在预览中。需要迁移私钥时，请同时选择原私钥文件；跳板链和非 SSH 连接不会导入。
- 分组总数修复：父组包含各级子组的已保存连接，搜索、展开和折叠不会改变分组右侧的总数。
- BLE 多适配器修复：已保存的连接会使用指定适配器，并阻止对同一设备发起重复连接。（PR #807）
⚡ 终端与命令栏
- 命令补全恢复：底部命令栏支持内置和自定义补全。没有历史记录也能从 docker 等命令获得候选；保存自定义补全规范后立即生效，历史补全照常可用。
- 右键三档可选：打开菜单、仅普通终端粘贴、始终粘贴。「仅普通终端粘贴」让启用鼠标跟踪的应用仍能收到右键；Shift+右键始终打开 OxideTerm 菜单。
- 焦点切换：从主机工具搜索框切回终端正文或命令栏时，Delete 交给新的输入目标，搜索词保持不变。
- 排版与滚动：新增字距设置，基于字体原生度量计算行高，并在升级时换算已保存的行高。滚动条不再占用内容宽度，搜索高亮和软换行文本的语义颜色在滚动时保持稳定；大量输出时也减少了终端网格锁竞争。（PR #802、#809）
- 首屏与全屏：SSH 首屏直接使用所选配色，打开 SSH 终端不再自动展开侧栏；macOS 切换全屏或显示缩放时不再用旧尺寸绘制新窗口。（PR #801）
🖥️ 工作区、插件与安装
- 新版锁屏与首次启动：锁屏采用双栏布局和挂锁动画，遵循减少动效设置。首次启动引导更短，新配置默认使用浅色 Code Light 和深色 GitHub Dark。
- 命令面板：键盘导航会跳过不可用选项，当前会话和最近使用项更容易辨认。
- 插件与 AI：修复 Windows 上以 .cmd 或 .bat 为入口的进程型插件无法启用的问题，普通 .exe 入口保持原有启动方式；修复部分 AI 提供方在多轮工具调用中丢失上下文的问题。（Windows 插件修复：PR #813）
- Kitty 文件传输授权：终端会话结束时撤销授权。旧确认框不能授权新会话，迟到的通知也不会清除重连后收到的新请求。（PR #803）
- macOS 安装包：使用 Developer ID 签名并经 Apple 公证。
- 内部整理：设置、连接、SFTP、文件管理、云同步和公开 MCP 等功能拆分为独立模块。
👥 贡献者
- 感谢 @alkaid-ops 实现连接前命令（PR #817）。
- 感谢 @allegrox 修复多适配器 BLE 连接和 Windows 进程型插件启动（PR #807、#813）。
- 感谢 @BilityLeu 修复终端首屏、macOS 全屏切换、滚动条和语义着色（PR #801、#802、#809）。
- 感谢 @m00nLi 修复 Kitty 文件传输授权的会话边界（PR #803）。
English
OxideTerm 2.4.0 adds pre-connect commands and SSH connection import from XTerminal, restores completion in the bottom command bar, and updates the lock screen, terminal typography, and session group counts.
🔌 Connections and Session Manager
- Pre-connect commands: Run a local command before a saved connection, for example to start a VPN or wake a host. A failure or timeout stops the attempt. Opening another terminal on an already connected node does not run the command again. (PR #817)
- SSH import from XTerminal: Passwords and key passphrases in the export go to protected credential storage and stay out of the preview. Select the original private key file to copy it; jump chains and non-SSH connections are not imported.
- Correct group totals: Parent groups count saved connections in every descendant group. Searching, expanding, or collapsing the tree leaves those totals unchanged.
- BLE adapter fixes: Saved connections use the selected adapter, and duplicate connection attempts to the same device are blocked. (PR #807)
⚡ Terminal and command bar
- Command completion restored: The bottom command bar offers built-in and custom completions. Commands such as docker show suggestions without history, custom specs take effect on save, and history suggestions still work.
- Three right-click actions: Choose Open Menu, Paste in Shell, or Always Paste. Paste in Shell passes right-clicks to apps that track the mouse; Shift+right-click always opens the OxideTerm menu.
- Focus handoff: Delete reaches the terminal or command bar after leaving the host-tools search field, without clearing the search query.
- Typography and scrolling: Added character spacing, based line height on native font metrics, and converted saved line heights on upgrade. Scrollbars no longer take up content width, search highlights and semantic colors on soft-wrapped lines stay stable while scrolling, and heavy output causes less terminal grid lock contention. (PR #802, #809)
- Startup and fullscreen: The first SSH frame uses the selected palette without automatically opening the sidebar. On macOS, fullscreen and display scaling changes no longer render an old-size frame. (PR #801)
🖥️ Workspace, plugins, and installation
- New lock screen and first-run setup: The lock screen has a two-panel layout and animated padlock that respects reduced motion. First-run setup is shorter, with Code Light and GitHub Dark as defaults for new profiles.
- Command palette: Keyboard navigation skips unavailable entries and makes the active session and recent items easier to identify.
- Plugins and AI: Fixed Windows process plugins that use .cmd or .bat launchers; ordinary .exe entries still launch as before. Also fixed some AI providers losing context across tool-call turns. (Windows plugin fix: PR #813)
- Kitty file-transfer approval: Approval is revoked when the terminal session ends. Old dialogs cannot authorize a new session, and late notifications no longer clear requests received after reconnection. (PR #803)
- macOS installers: Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
- Internal organization: Split settings, connections, SFTP, file management, cloud sync, and Public MCP into independent modules.
👥 Contributors
- Thanks to @alkaid-ops for pre-connect commands (PR #817).
- Thanks to @allegrox for fixing multi-adapter BLE connections and Windows process plugin startup (PR #807, #813).
- Thanks to @BilityLeu for the terminal startup, macOS fullscreen, scrollbar, and semantic-color fixes (PR #801, #802, #809).
- Thanks to @m00nLi for fixing the session boundary for Kitty file-transfer approval (PR #803).

📌 Installation Tips / 安装提示
macOS
Downloaded .dmg files may be quarantined by Gatekeeper. Run in Terminal:
xattr -cr ~/Downloads/OxideTerm_*.dmg
# or after install / 或安装后
xattr -cr /Applications/OxideTerm.app
Windows
If SmartScreen warns, click More info -> Run anyway.
若 SmartScreen 弹出警告，点击 更多信息 -> 仍要运行。
Linux
# AppImage
chmod +x OxideTerm_*_linux_*.AppImage && ./OxideTerm_*_linux_*.AppImage
# Debian/Ubuntu
sudo dpkg -i OxideTerm_*_linux_*.deb && sudo apt-get install -f
# Fedora/RHEL-compatible systems
sudo dnf install ./OxideTerm_*_linux_*.rpm
